_comment: The lens — WHAT to watch. Marketing-intelligence focus, tilted to the pharma / healthcare / life-sciences vertical. Per topic: 'category' (= a brief section), 'tier' (primary=pillar / context=scan), 'exa_queries' (semantic search, preferred), 'gnews' (a Google News RSS URL as the always-on floor when Exa is off), and 'rss' (clean publisher feeds). Private client/brand watches live in clients.local.json (gitignored) — NEVER here. A topic may set its own 'lookback_days'. Dedupe + memory live in scripts/state.py.

exa_queries: marketing mix modeling pharma OR healthcare
media mix model healthcare brand measurement
incrementality testing pharma OR healthcare marketing
pharma commercial data platform OR analytics engineering
healthcare marketing semantic layer OR data warehouse
pharma marketing data governance OR MLR review
agentic analytics healthcare OR life sciences

_lookback_note: Weekly cadence (analytics brief, Mondays) → a 9-day window gives ~2 days overlap so a slightly-late run misses nothing. News IS deduped by normalized URL in state.py, so overlap costs a little fetching but never a repeat. Client watches in clients.local.json override with their own lookback_days (30) for the slower bi-weekly radar.
